Deliverable D1 · Open community directory

Networking European security knowledge.

Aim of the ActionEuropean security research is scattered across borders, institutions and disciplines. NetSec connects this dispersed community into one open, pan-European network — so scholars across 30+ countries can share knowledge, train the next generation, and build a more inclusive and representative field. This site is its public face and open directory.
